camel_example: aliyun sas CreateOssBucketScanTask --region cn-hangzhou --AllKeyPrefix true --KeySuffixList.1 '.jsp' --BucketNameList.1 'hz-yqq-standard0000' --ScanMode 1 --DecryptionList.1 KMS --KeyPrefixList.1 '/root' --LastModifiedStartTime 1724301769834 --DecompressMaxFileCount 100 --ExcludeKeySuffixList.1 '.jsp' --DecompressMaxLayer 1
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-oss-bucket-scan-task --bucket-name-list hz-yqq-standard0000 --exclude-key-suffix-list .jsp --scan-mode 1 --key-suffix-list .jsp --key-prefix-list /root --all-key-prefix true --decompress-max-layer 1 --decompress-max-file-count 100 --decryption-list KMS --last-modified-start-time 1724301769834 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOssBucketScanTask

parameters.help_en: The suffixes of the objects that you do not want to check
parameters.help_zh: 不检测的文件后缀列表
parameters.name: exclude_key_suffix_list

parameters.help_en:
The check mode. Valid values:

1: checks all objects in the bucket.
2: checks only new objects in the bucket
parameters.help_zh:
检测模式。取值：

1：全量文件检测。

2：增量文件检测
parameters.name: scan_mode

parameters.help_en: The suffixes of the objects that you want to check
parameters.name: key_suffix_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to match the prefixes of all objects
parameters.help_zh: 是否匹配所有前缀。此参数设置为true时，参数KeyPrefixList不生效
parameters.name: all_key_prefix

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of decompression levels when multi-level packages are decompressed. Valid values: 1 to 5. If the maximum number of decompression levels is reached, the decompression operation immediately ends and the detection of extracted objects is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 存在多个层级的压缩包嵌套时的最大解压层数，最小取值为1，最大取值为5。超过最大解压层数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_layer

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of objects that can be extracted during decompression. Valid values: 1 to 1000. If the maximum number of objects that can be extracted is reached, the decompression operation immediately ends and the detection of extracted objects is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 最大解压文件数。最小取值为1，最大取值为1000。超过最大解压文件数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_file_count

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the object was last modified. The time must be later than the timestamp that you specify. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检测最后一次修改时间在指定时间戳之后的文件，单位毫秒
parameters.name: last_modified_start_time
